applications.description:
Demolition and redevelopment of the site to provide a mixed use scheme comprising up to 583 residential units (Class C3 and including Private Rented Sector) in 8 buildings
ranging from 4 to 18 storeys, commercial uses (flexible retail, community and leisure uses), new access from Fulbourne Road, car parking; provision of new
plant and renewable energy equipment; creation of servicing areas and provision of associated services, including waste, refuse, cycle storage, and lighting; and new routes and open spaces within the development and associated works and operations. (Amended description - Further information/amended Environmental Impact Assessment).

game.plainAsk: Knock what's there and put up 583 homes.
game.plainImpact: 583 homes, 20% affordable vs London Plan 35%. This is a major under the usual 35%. Street-crime count in May 2026 is high (575 within 400 m, locations approximate). This borough's 2023–24 affordable pace was 490.

applications.description: Variation of Conditions 2, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 28, 30, 31, 32, 34, 35  and removal of Condition 14 (Road Safety Audit) attached to planning permission reference 232616 granted 30/01/2026, amended by reference 260391 granted 17/07/2026, to allow for:“Demolition of existing buildings and construction of buildings ranging between two and six storeys across Sites A and B, comprising 361m2 of Class E commercial floorspace at ground floor and 47 residential units, together with 2 disabled parking spaces, cycle stores, refuse stores and landscaping.”Amendments to Condition 2 (Approved Plans):Subdivision of the Site B commercial unit into two units and extension of footprint.Reconfiguration of all flats across the ground, first, second, third, fourth and fifth floors.Removal of the Site B sixth floor and raising of the Site B fifth‑floor parapets to the corner block and raising of the second‑floor service yard parapet.Replication of the Site B third‑floor layout at fourth‑floor level to the middle block on Coopers Lane.Introduction of a new 1‑bed unit and associated access changes at Site B fifth‑floor level.Internal reconfiguration of corridors, stair cores, MEP risers and means of escape within Site B.Increase to internal floor heights and building heights.Fenestration changes (reduction in size of glazed shopfront and number of doors to Site B glazed shopfront commercial doors on the High Road Leyton elevation.Separate final means of escape door introduced on Cooper’s Lane elevation.Fenestration amendments to the internal courtyard (small adjustment to window and door positions and omission of a glazed panel to a window) .Amendments to Conditions 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 28, 30, 31 and 32 to distinguish between Site A and Site B and Condition 34 (Wheelchair units) to update the trigger point relating to M4(3) adaptable units.

pipr.sourceWorkbook: ONS Price Index of Private Rents UK monthly price statistics, 19 August 2026

affordableHousingSupply.note: Win condition uses this completions pace, not the London Plan 35% policy target.

nursePay.hcas: Inner London 20% of basic, min £5,794 max £8,746 from 1 April 2026
nursePay.note: Outer London HCAS is lower than Inner. Take-home still uses the Inner Band 5 entry figure until we re-derive Outer 2026/27 — not an invented Outer salary.

takeHomeAssumptions.note: Transparent 2026/27 England PAYE sketch for the nurse only (NHS pension). Private renter has no pension deduction in this model. Not official tax tables.

nurse.label: Band 5 nurse
nurse.housing: houseshare at 42% of PIPR 1-bed (full 1-bed already exceeds 40% take-home at baseline)

renter.label: Private renter
renter.incomeNote: Modelled inner-London professional salary for the scenario, not ASHE/median. Tenure mix (36.2% PRS) is 2018.

family.label: Family of four
family.incomeNote: Two Inner London Band 5 entry salaries as a visible public-service household, not a household-income survey.

stakes.snapshotNote: Official snapshot, not live. TA not in this pack unless extracted per borough — do not use Tower Hamlets 3,096 here.

crimeNote: Street-crime counts are precomputed per application from data.police.uk May 2026. No point cloud shipped.
